title: Analysis of Integrin-Mediated Cell Adhesion in Zebrafish Lateral Plate Mesoderm Cells
author: Rho, Oguri-Nakamura, et al.

steps.title: Prepare breeding tank and initiate spawning
steps.instruction: Transfer Tg(fli1a:EGFP)y1 zebrafish into a breeding tank where males and females are separated by a divider during the afternoon or evening; control the light cycle at 14 h light/10 h dark with an automatic timer; the next morning when the lights turn on, remove the divider to start breeding and reduce the water volume in the tank to facilitate spawning.

steps.title: Collect embryos and rinse
steps.instruction: Fifteen to thirty minutes after spawning begins, remove the adult fish; pour the water and embryos through a mesh tea strainer; rinse the embryos on the strainer with 0.03 % sea‑salt solution.

steps.title: Wash embryos into E3 medium dishes
steps.instruction: Transfer the rinsed embryos into a 10‑cm petri dish containing E3 medium and keep them at a density of fewer than 30 embryos per dish in E3 medium at 28 °C until they reach 17 h post‑fertilization (hpf).

steps.title: Dechorionate embryos with Pronase
steps.instruction: At 17 hpf, move the embryos to glass beakers, incubate them in Pronase solution at 20–25 °C for 5–10 min while gently mixing once per minute and monitoring chorion rupture; when chorions begin to break, wash the embryos several times with E3 medium, pipet them back and forth in E3 medium using a plastic Pasteur pipette to remove remaining chorions, and collect the dechorionated embryos in a 10‑cm petri dish containing E3 medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate embryos in Pronase (20–25 °C, 5–10 min) with gentle mixing.
Wash embryos repeatedly with E3 medium once chorions start to open.
Pipet embryos in E3 medium to mechanically remove chorions.
Collect dechorionated embryos in a petri dish with E3 medium.

steps.title: Enzymatic dissociation of embryos
steps.instruction: Transfer fifteen dechorionated embryos into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, wash once with 1 mL PBS, add 500 µL of 1× Liberase solution and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h mixing gently every 20 min with a P1000 pipette; then add 1 mL Liberase termination solution and mix to stop the reaction, followed by gentle pipetting with a P1000 to dissociate the cells.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with 500 µL 1× Liberase at 37 °C for 1 h, mixing every 20 min.
Add 1 mL Liberase termination solution and mix.
Gently pipette to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Filter and pellet cell suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the dissociated cells through a 100‑µm cell strainer into a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube, centrifuge at 1,600 rpm (≈250 × g) for 3 min at 15–25 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL DPBS.

steps.title: Wash adherent cells before fixation
steps.instruction: Gently wash the cells that have adhered to the fibronectin‑coated dish with PBS twice.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells with fixative solution for 20 min at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the cells with permeabilization solution for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with PBS three times briefly, then incubate them with blocking solution for 90 min at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with rabbit anti‑GFP (1:300) and mouse anti‑vinculin (1:300) antibodies diluted in PBS at 4 °C for 12–16 h.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with PBS three times, 10 min each.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (dark)
steps.instruction: In the dark, incubate the cells with PBS containing Alexa Fluor 488‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG (1:1000) and Alexa Fluor 564‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse IgG (1:1000) for 2 h at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with PBS six times, 10 min each (keep in the dark).

steps.title: Phalloidin staining (dark)
steps.instruction: In the dark, incubate the cells with PBS containing Alexa Fluor 633‑conjugated phalloidin (1:1000) for 2 h at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Final washes and storage
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with PBS three times, 10 min each, submerge them in PBS, and store the stained cells in the dark at 4 °C for several days.

steps.title: Open images in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Launch ImageJ and install the Bio‑Formats plugin to open Olympus OIF files.

steps.title: Create Z‑projection
steps.instruction: Select Image → Stacks → Z Project to generate a Z‑projection of each image stack.

steps.title: Set image scale if needed
steps.instruction: If scale information is missing, draw a straight line of known distance on a calibration image, then choose Image → Analyze → Set Scale, enter the known distance and units, check ‘Global’, and click OK.

steps.title: Select GFP cell and clear outside
steps.instruction: Draw a freehand outline around the GFP‑positive cell and choose Edit → Clear Outside to isolate the cell.

steps.title: Split channels and select vinculin
steps.instruction: Use Image → Color → Split Channels and select the Alexa Fluor 546 (vinculin) channel for further analysis.

steps.title: Subtract background
steps.instruction: Choose Process → Subtract Background, select the Sliding Paraboloid option and set the Rolling ball radius to 50 pixels.

steps.title: Enhance local contrast (CLAHE)
steps.instruction: Install the CLAHE plugin, then run Plugin → CLAHE with block size = 19, histogram bin = 256, and maximum slope = 6.

steps.title: Apply exponential background reduction
steps.instruction: Select Process → Math → Exp to minimize background.

steps.title: Adjust brightness and contrast
steps.instruction: Open Image → Adjust → Brightness/Contrast, click Auto, then Apply.

steps.title: Apply Log3D filter
steps.instruction: Install the Log3D plugin, then run Plugin → Log3D and set sigma X = 3 and sigma Y = 3.

steps.title: Set threshold
steps.instruction: Choose Image → Adjust → Threshold and click Apply.

steps.title: Analyze particles for focal adhesions
steps.instruction: Select Analyze → Analyze Particles → Threshold, set Size = 0–infinity and Circularity = 0.00–0.99, choose Show: Outlines, and enable Display results and Summarize.
